reference: User-supplied Counter / Sweep / Sundering Art / Smash / Strike screenshot, latest turn. This replaces the polished master-sheet style as the visual target.

codeScheme.letter: object-family category; card types reference families
codeScheme.zero: Zero is a real object/effect option, never absence.

examples.A30: Object 3 with effect 0; use object-only view to hide the effect
examples.A04: Object 0 with effect 4; use effect-only view to hide the object

codeScheme.orientation: Rotation metadata references the exact same PNG; candidate images are alternatives, not claimed to be multiple camera views of one master.
codeScheme.selection: Multiple objects, effects and combinations may be retained. Selecting an effect does not automatically select the object shown beside it.
codeScheme.isolation: Layer visibility is independent of the selection code. Each component has its own asset ID, PNG and controls.

scope.confirmed: Ten variants of each of seven core object families: 70 core objects. Cleansed fire is an additional family. Effects and backgrounds are separate.
scope.deferred: Ten-option exploration of every element and status family.

style.composition: Large close-cropped heavy objects occupying 65–85% of art area; diagonal handles and blades; cropped handles may enter from the lower/upper edge; dark negative space reserved for motion arcs.
style.material: Worn dark painted metal, irregular chunky planes, subdued bronze; tactile soft painterly rendering, not clean vector icons, ornate silver engraving or glossy catalog objects.
style.light: Most edges and background near black; local colored edge illumination and fog follows motion/contact.
style.isolation: Object-only views have no magical effects. Effect-only views contain no object, weapon silhouette, card face, or stand-in. They share the same placement coordinates as their combination.
style.boundaries: No card border, title, costs, rank, rules text or UI from the reference is part of the art. Labels belong outside each study.
style.production: Actual individual PNG exports. Objects and effects have transparent backgrounds; backgrounds are separate opaque PNGs. Source atlases are internal generation provenance, not the deliverable format.

cardTypes.proposal: One sword; dark navy and gold or teal edge fog.
One shield; charcoal and silver edge fog.
Reuse a selected shield plus selected sword, independently positioned.
One hammer; dark gold and red impact fog.
Choose scimitar or scythe; red-black motion arc.
A spell-card object is the current seven-family proposal; future orb or focus is optional.
Use a card for draw/retain, a leaf for nature-related skills.
Reuse the object associated with the power and a stronger secondary aura.
Leaf for herb consumables; card for scroll-like consumables. Bottle remains an optional future family.
Use an appropriate reusable symbol plus a status overlay; Cleansed explicitly uses H fire.
